rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/high-quality blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona consistent with reported 3AA; appropriately notes image/focal-plane limits. Slight overreach in suggesting possible 4AA/full-to-hatching without firm visual confirmation.

Strong integration of maternal age-related aneuploidy risk, ovarian reserve, prior IVF history, endometrial thickness, BMI/lifestyle, semen parameters, and partner age with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Overall logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately centered on age-related euploidy uncertainty despite good morphology. Minor issue: implantation range is somewhat broad and mixes implantation with center-specific expectations.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: supports single embryo transfer, cautions against unproven add-ons, and frames PGT-A as a discussion rather than mandate. Slightly stronger claims about PGT-A benefits than some guidelines would universally endorse.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including luteal support, uterine optimization, and structured review after failure. Useful but not highly specific to protocol details or thresholds.
